data: Is the blue line on the left plot higher than the red line at encoder layer 2?

The blue line represents the fraction of compute used per layer for the self-attention sub-network (SA) at a computation budget of p=0.2. The red line represents the fraction of compute used per layer for the feed-forward (FF) sub-network at a computation budget of p=0.2. At encoder layer 2, the blue line is higher than the red line. Therefore, the answer is yes.
